targets.name: Blue throw
targets.notes: One blue woven throw hangs over the upper railing, with its cream fringe included. It shares the rail with a separate cream cloth; the crop preserves the actual fabric and fringe instead of masking individual threads.

targets.name: Flower picture
targets.notes: The lower framed botanical picture on the right wall contains one pink flower and green leaves. The whole wooden frame is included; the upper landscape painting is separate.

targets.name: Brass mister
targets.notes: The small brass plant mister sits deep on the upper shelf beside trailing greenery. The outline follows its reservoir, two finger loops and vertical pump; loop interiors are excluded. A separate dark stem on the wall to its left is not part of the target.

targets.name: Blue lidded tin
targets.notes: A small blue-and-white lidded tin is tucked below the ribbon rack. The hanging cream ribbon overlaps its left side; the lid knob, rim, cylindrical body and painted decoration remain visible in the unchanged source crop.

targets.name: Floral card
targets.notes: A botanical card leans among hanging ribbons in the middle-distance shelf. Its whole printed face remains visible.

targets.name: Green tin
targets.notes: Small sage tin blends with the shelving; brass clasp and handle identify the whole box.

targets.name: Floral teacup
targets.notes: A small floral teacup sits on a tray among the teapot and biscuits. Outline follows the cup and handle only; the saucer is context.

targets.name: Metal watering can
targets.notes: The can sits behind a basket. The checked cloth hides the lower-left spout/body connection; its metal handle, rose and cylinder remain recognizable.

targets.name: Striped jug
targets.notes: The cream jug shares the pale ceramics elsewhere but is the only foreground jug with two blue stripes; the full silhouette stays readable.

targets.name: Pruning shears
targets.notes: Open pruning shears are tucked into the apron pocket. Both blades and red grips remain visible; the pocket naturally hides the grip ends.

targets.name: Floral glove
targets.notes: A single patterned glove hangs over the crate edge. Include its folded striped cuff and all five visible fingers; colors blend with wood and linen.

targets.name: Blue paper roll
targets.notes: Blue patterned wrapping paper leans among other rolls. The wicker basket hides its bottom and the kraft roll overlaps the lower left; the rolled top remains clear.

review.notes: Scene-first composition; twelve real ordinary objects selected after inspection. Every source crop and manually authored contour reviewed enlarged. Context previews preserve the actual overlap, color and shape. Phone emulation proof and player feedback are separate; no physical iPhone review claimed.
